discovery.title: UN climate talks enter crunch time with no deal in sight
discovery.summary: The U.N.'s COP31 climate talks enter their endgame Friday, with countries sharply divided over a draft deal lacking any mention of planet-heating fossil fuels, threatening to push the negotiations into overtime.
